photo.fileTitle: File:Erosion Damage, Wilsons Promontory, Australia - Mar 2012.jpg
photo.caption: Erosion damage caused by the March 2011 floods, as viewed southwards towards Lilly Pilly Gully, March 2012.
photo.description: A view looking south towards Lilly Pilly Gully of the erosion damage caused by the March 2011 floods in Wilsons Promontory. The forest was completely stripped and a deep gully created, in which ~400mm of rain fell in a 24 hour period.
